question: Could you help me calculate the average of the total number of payments made using the most preferred payment method for each product category, where the most preferred payment method in a category is the one with the highest number of payments?
sql:
WITH payment_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_category_name,
        op.payment_type,
        COUNT(*) as payment_count
    FROM olist_order_payments op
    JOIN olist_orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_category_name, op.payment_type
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        payment_type,
        payment_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY payment_count DESC) as rnk
    FROM payment_counts
),
most_preferred AS (
    SELECT product_category_name, payment_type
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rnk = 1
),
category_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        mp.product_category_name,
        mp.payment_type,
        SUM(pc.payment_count) as total_payments
    FROM most_preferred mp
    JOIN payment_counts pc 
        ON mp.product_category_name = pc.product_category_name 
        AND mp.payment_type = pc.payment_type
    GROUP BY mp.product_category_name, mp.payment_type
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as num_categories,
    AVG(total_payments) as avg_total_payments,
    SUM(total_payments) as sum_total_payments,
    MIN(total_payments) as min_total_payments,
    MAX(total_payments) as max_total_payments
FROM category_totals
